# Palouse Water Pros

> Palouse Water Pros is a water treatment sales, installation, and service business owned and operated by Trent, based in Moscow, Idaho, serving Moscow and the greater Palouse region of north-central Idaho (Latah County, ID).

## Services
- Water softeners and hard water treatment
- Whole house water filtration (city and well water)
- Iron and manganese removal for challenging well water
- Reverse osmosis drinking water systems
- On-site water testing and consultation
- New construction and custom water system design

## Service area
- Based in Moscow, Idaho; serves Latah County and the Idaho side of the Palouse
- Towns served: Moscow, Viola, Troy, Deary, Bovill, Genesee, Kendrick, Juliaetta, Potlatch, Princeton, Harvard
- Service-area pages:
  - Moscow city water and Viola: https://palousewaterpros.com/moscow-city-water-treatment.html
  - Troy, Deary, Bovill, Helmer (Highway 8): https://palousewaterpros.com/troy-deary-bovill-water-treatment.html
  - Genesee and south Latah County: https://palousewaterpros.com/genesee-water-treatment.html
  - Kendrick and Juliaetta (Potlatch River canyon): https://palousewaterpros.com/kendrick-juliaetta-water-treatment.html
  - Princeton, Potlatch, Harvard (Highway 6): https://palousewaterpros.com/princeton-potlatch-water-treatment.html

## Key facts
- Owner-operated; the owner personally tests water on-site, designs the system, and performs the installation
- Specializes in Palouse-region well water problems, especially high iron, manganese, and hardness
- Timeline: honest, job-specific estimates given after the on-site visit
- Approach: honest, low-pressure, tailored recommendations; industry-standard serviceable equipment
- Contact: call (208) 883-4444; text (949) 456-6889
